sn40.7:1.4: Idha bhikkhu sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma Natthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanam upasampajja viharati ||
sn40.7:1.6: So khvāham āvuso sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma Natthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanam upasampajja viharāmi ||
sn40.7:1.7: tassa mayham āvuso iminā vihārena viharato viññāṇañcāyatanasahagatā saññā manasikārā samudācaranti || || 6
sn40.7:2.1: Atha kho mam āvuso Bhagavā iddhiyā upasaṅkamitvā etad avoca ||
sn40.7:2.3: mā brāhmaṇa ākiñcaññāyatanam pamādo ākiñcaññāyatane cittaṃ saṇṭhapehi ākiñcaññāyatane cittam ekodikarohi ākiñcaññāyatane cittaṃ samādahāti || || 7
sn40.7:2.4: So khvāham āvuso aparena samayena sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma Natthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanam upasampajja vihāsiṃ || || 8
sn40.7:2.5: Yaṃ hi tam āvuso sammāvadamāno vadeyya || pe || mahābhiññatam patto
